reason: My architect already does the 3D models and renders, and it's baked into their fee. I'm not paying a second company to redo something I already get.
objection: Why would I pay $1,500 a home for something my architect already hands me? And I get calls from people pitching this kind of thing all the time.
would_change_my_mind: If it was cheaper than what my architect charges me for renders and I could show it to buyers before I even hire an architect, I'd look at it. Otherwise no.
